title: On the Definition and Smooth Examples of Weakly Kähler--Finsler Metrics
summary: The generalization of the Kähler metric in the complex Finsler setting admits four natural versions. Among these, the strongly Kähler--Finsler condition is known to coincide with one of the intermediate conditions. In this paper, we establish the equivalence between the weakly Kähler--Finsler condition and the remaining intermediate condition. Moreover, we obtain new necessary and sufficient conditions for a weakly Kähler--Finsler metric to be strongly Kähler--Finsler.
